sentence: This project builds virtual assistants using artificial intelligence and tests how different designs affect learning behaviors in biology and bioinformatics courses.
This project acquires a liquid chromatography mass spectrometer that separates and identifies small molecules in samples from synthetic chemistry and synthetic biology experiments.
This project builds tools into workflow systems that track where data came from, so that scientific results are reliable and reproducible.
This project designs algorithms and prototype chips that run brain-inspired spiking neural networks using little memory and power on small edge devices.
This project studies whether hybrid chickadees survive less well and have less efficient metabolisms than non-hybrid chickadees, using whole genome sequence data and data from backyard bird feeders.
This project does laboratory experiments on ice under space-like conditions to find out how complex organic molecules containing carbon, hydrogen, oxygen and nitrogen form.
This project builds a software platform using artificial intelligence and physics to speed up the design of masks for extreme ultraviolet lithography.
This project builds fast computer methods that use random probes to find hidden structure in very large matrices, so simulations run faster and use less memory.
This project studies medical devices in biomedical engineering, with a focus on how human factors engineering can prevent bias in medical products.
This project builds open-source software libraries that run optimal control calculations for robotics on graphics processing units, with benchmark problems to compare methods.
This project acquires an instrument that measures the structure and composition of materials at the surface and below it, using several spectroscopy methods.
This project writes course materials for introductory quantum computing, quantum machine learning and quantum chemistry using active learning methods.
This project keeps measuring the water chemistry of large Arctic rivers and studies what caused it to change over time.
This project develops a nanoparticle coating that disinfects surfaces of viruses and bacteria and works out how to make it at larger scale.
This project uses a 3-dimensional motion capture system to collect and analyze human movement data with computer vision and machine learning.
